parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, elongated and slightly tapered for comfortable grip.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the ink refill and provides the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the pen’s internal components.
